digest.component_or_area: per-worker rebar repo template fixture in tests/interfaces conftest
propositions: The template fixture must assert the freshly built template contains no tickets, not just that no .rebar directory exists.
The no-tickets assertion must live inside the MonkeyPatch context where REBAR_ROOT and cwd are pinned at the template.
The existing .rebar absence check is retained as a plain filesystem test after the MonkeyPatch context exits.
A test-level virginity check only protects runs that select that test, leaving narrowed runs unprotected, so enforcement belongs at fixture construction.
The assertion is load-bearing: seeding a ticket into the template makes the fixture raise, and removing it restores identical passed/skipped counts.
test_template_stays_virgin is retained and continues to document the invariant from a test context.
